name: @zot-core/cli
description: Command-line interface for the Zot API. Create and manage waitlists, API keys, and more from the terminal.
author: Zot

waitlist.description: Manage Zot waitlists (create, list, inspect, etc.).

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && node scripts/post-build.mjs
